method: Knee-rigid vertices from actual decoded LOD0. Inverse bind transforms normalized raw positions to knee-local physical coordinates, including quantization compensation. Foot region is below rest sole minimum +0.28m. Greedy extrema cache validated against all full-foot vertices at every authored idle/walk/turn key, with 0.25mm target tolerance and maximum16 points. No runtime per-frame vertex scan required.
limitations: No ankle or foot joints exist. Knee-to-sole distance is a virtual contact segment, not an anatomical shin length.
Ground sample values are uncorrected model-space minimum foot heights, not stance errors: elevated swing feet should not be forcibly planted.
Cached extrema prove support at sampled keys; dense interpolation and runtime blended poses need validation.

Sovereign source is refined uncompressed master; other assets are current decoded mobile variants. Use runtime skeleton bone.matrixWorld plus the supplied knee-local points; do not apply quantized mesh scale a second time.
